evidence.coverage: Gold study metadata and aggregate PE/CT and PK-summary outcome rows; Silver automated study-type labels. Individual-patient outcomes, PK parameter tables and Silver drug/population mappings excluded.
evidence.guidance_origin: Coverage, search, linkage and interpretation caveats are MCP implementation guidance, not quotations from MPRINT dataset authors or original papers.
evidence.coverage_notice: Versioned export, not the complete live portals. Filters and row limits can omit records; an empty result is not an evidence-gap finding.
evidence.caveat: Publication inclusion/classification is not proof of efficacy, safety, study quality, or MPRINT funding. Read the original paper. Snapshot absence is not absence of evidence.
evidence.filter_scope: Conservative matches on source population text; generic maternal does not imply pregnancy or lactation. Original mixed population labels are preserved, not exclusive cohorts.
evidence.search_scope: Any searched name may match; all tokens of that name must match curated drug fields. Ingredient matches do not establish combination-product evidence. Sorted by descending PMID, not publication date; multiple rows can describe one paper.

population_coverage.notice: Search bands are prototype conventions, not clinical equivalence. Preserve actual source ages, gestational age and prematurity. A broad pediatric record does not establish evidence for the requested band.

evidence_status.message: Retrieved material is not a safety verdict; missing evidence is not evidence of safety.

safety.scope: Public evidence and resource navigation; not individual treatment or eligibility decisions.
rules: Do not infer safety, drug identity, or absence of evidence from missing or empty results.
Do not provide doses, missed-dose plans, schedules, tapers or personal start/stop/change decisions.
Separate source findings, monitoring recommendations, exposure measurements and causal claims.
Call route_parent_question before parent-facing chat; urgent concerns take precedence over retrieval.
Do not collect identifiable histories or submit reports, comments or enrollment applications.

payload.disclaimer: Informational only; not medical advice. Compiled from public NIH/NLM/FDA data, which may be incomplete or out of date. Patients should talk to a clinician, pharmacist or poison control before starting, stopping or changing any medication.
